scope.eligible_rows: Only selected, rights-pass, still-target-unexposed document rows produced under the frozen sampling frame after IR-127 fixes n_h.
scope.assignment_time: After source and sample materialization but before candidate search, annotation, guide piloting, system development on project data, or disclosure of split membership.
scope.unit: One immutable page/revision document; every retained paragraph, candidate, occurrence, annotation, and prediction inherits its document split.
scope.human_work_gate: This protocol does not authorize annotation. GOVERNANCE.md and resources/ethics_determination.md remain controlling while institutional determination is pending.

partitions.permitted_use: Create examples, train annotators, and revise the annotation guide; never report as held-out performance.
Estimate workload and preliminary agreement and refine procedures; labels and results are exposed development evidence.
Debug metrics, select transparent baselines, and tune at most the prospectively authorized system components.
One locked final evaluation after guide, inventory, metrics, systems, and predictions are frozen.

assignment.design: Independent deterministic random partition within each frozen sampling-length stratum.
assignment.hash: SHA-256 of compact UTF-8 JSON [protocol_id, seed, page_id, revision_id]
assignment.order: Sort ascending by split hash, then page_id and revision_id, separately within short, medium, and long.
assignment.integer_counts: For each length stratum, floor share*n_h for every partition, then assign remaining rows by descending fractional remainder; ties use sealed_test, development, guide_training, annotation_pilot order.
fail_closed_conditions: A page_id, revision_id, or immutable_source_id appears more than once.
Any document or any retained fragment of that document is assigned to more than one partition.
Any required partition receives zero documents in a sampling-length stratum.
A target, MWE, dictionary, label, model, outcome, or burden field enters assignment.
A split is rebalanced after any target or label exposure.

developer_visible: annotation_pilot text, labels, agreement, and burden
development text, labels, predictions, and metrics
public external resources already marked exposed in resources/leakage_ledger.json
sealed_until_prediction_commitment: sealed_test predictions, metrics, errors, and strata counts that reveal labels
information_boundary.prediction_commitment: Before scoring, hash and timestamp each final system identity, code/configuration, dependency/model identity, and complete sealed-test prediction file. No rerun becomes the primary result.
information_boundary.one_run_rule: The custodian performs one planned scoring run. A technical failure may be rerun only with the same committed predictions and a logged non-analytic correction; otherwise it is a new exposed evaluation version.
information_boundary.release_rule: Reveal test membership, labels, and results only after the frozen run and decision-log entry; release does not permit retrospective tuning or relabeling of the same version.

custody.eligible_role: A named person who did not develop or tune the evaluated systems and can withhold the test material and score it independently.
conflicts: person who selected a result for publication after viewing test scores
shared credential or storage location accessible to developers before commitment
required_record_before_materialization: custodian name or stable role identifier
custody.stop_rule: Without an eligible named custodian, do not create or claim a project sealed test.

form_disjoint_policy.permitted_current_claim: Report the test_unseen occurrence stratum defined in resources/evaluation_strata.json, with document and canonical-form cluster counts, only at the precision level authorized by IR-127.
form_disjoint_policy.activation_gate: A separate versioned addendum must be accepted before developers see candidate or label data. A non-developer custodian must group the document-canonical_type_id bipartite graph into connected components, assign whole components, demonstrate adequate precision, and disclose imbalance without moving rows for better scores.
form_disjoint_policy.failure_rule: If shared forms create an infeasible giant component or the precision target fails, omit the strong unseen-form claim rather than deleting forms, moving documents post hoc, or calling occurrence-level novelty a form-disjoint test.

external_evidence_roles.STREUSLE_5_0: Exposed external development/smoke-test evidence only, including its 40 projected test occurrences; never part of the new sealed test.
external_evidence_roles.Raganato_WSD_slice: Exposed external sense-ranking smoke test only, including 17 source-test rows; never part of the new sealed test.
external_evidence_roles.dictionary_and_inventory_candidates: Permitted inventory-development evidence but not contextual gold, an unseen-form guarantee, or a project sealed-test label.

current_boundary.claim_ceiling: split assignment and custody protocol only; no held-out evidence exists

change_rule: Changing shares, assignment fields, seed, integer allocation, information access, custody, or form-disjoint policy requires a new split-protocol version. After any test exposure, the changed rule applies only to a new sealed test.
